content.name: Black Market Leads
content.description:
Black marketeers are placed on about one station per sector at the start of the game, and then hidden. They are not in the bar, they are not in the station's people list, and nothing on the map points at them - the game moves the character into the bar only after you have already unlocked him.
The only way in is a signal leak on the station hull: the first mission leak on a station that has a marketeer is always the timed illegal-item delivery whose reward is literally "Access to unsanctioned trade offers". Which means you can fly around a station in scan mode for twenty minutes and come away with nothing, because you never had any way of knowing whether that station was worth scanning in the first place.
[h2]What this mod does[/h2] [list] [*][b]Tells you which station is worth scanning.[/b] The first time you are in a sector with a black marketeer aboard a station [b]you already know[/b], you get one logbook entry under Tips. Click it and the map opens on that station. [*][b]Makes the scan pay off.[/b] While you are there, the mod asks the game to run its own signal leak pass on that station, so the unlock lead actually gets placed instead of maybe getting placed. [/list]
[b]It does not hand you the galaxy.[/b] Only stations the game already considers known to you are ever reported, listed or touched. A marketeer in a sector you have never visited stays exactly as invisible as it is in vanilla. You still fly there, you still scan the hull, you still run the delivery.
[h2]The thing nobody tells you[/h2] A black marketeer can only be unlocked on a station you are allowed to dock at. Without docking permission the game creates the lead and then destroys it again a moment later, which is the real reason some stations never reward scanning no matter how long you spend on them. The mod never wastes a lead on such a station, and says so in the logbook entry and in the menu.
[h2]Where to change things[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed: [b]Options - Extension Options - Black Market Leads[/b].
Without that API the mod still runs: the logbook entries, the ticker lines and the lead planting all work off the constants at the top of md/drjele_black_market_leads.xml, re-read on every savegame load. Any other mod or cheat menu can override them at runtime through the globals $DrJeleBlackMarketForceLeaks, $DrJeleBlackMarketForceCooldown, $DrJeleBlackMarketLogbook, $DrJeleBlackMarketNotify, $DrJeleBlackMarketOnlyLead and $DrJeleBlackMarketDebugChance.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the in-game settings menu. Everything works without it. [*]No DLC required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame. No vanilla file is patched: the whole mod is two Mission Director scripts that read the game's own black marketeer table and signal the game's own signal leak manager, so it is save-compatible in both directions and cannot collide with another mod's XPath.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-black-market-leads

text.name: Black Market Leads
text.description: Black marketeers are hidden until you unlock them, and the only way in is a signal leak on the station hull - with no way of telling which station is worth scanning. This reports the ones on stations you already know, makes sure scanning them actually produces the unlock lead, and keeps a list. Only stations known to you; exploration still does the work.

dependency.name: SirNukes Mod Support APIs
dependency.comment: menu, options and right-click entry; the mod works without it
